latest_release.name: v3.9.0-p2
latest_release.body:
**Changes:**

- Using the latest base image [v3.9.0-p2](https://github.com/appium/appium-docker-android/releases/tag/v3.9.0-p2)
- Able to pass gpu mode via environment variable
- Disable Animations for better performance
- Bump click to version 8.5.1
- Bump coverage to version 7.17.2
- Bump fastmcp to version 4.1.7
- Bump pytest to version 9.2.0
